snippet.title: Aisle Of Shadows - Horror Game Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 Wishlist & Demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4836250/Aisle_of_Shadows/

https://discord.gg/TqAySUTAxW

Aisle of Shadows is a first-person psychological horror game set inside a shopping mall that feels strangely familiar—yet deeply wrong. What begins as a simple task slowly unravels into an unsettling journey through distorted memories, forgotten stories, and a world where reality becomes increasingly uncertain.

Explore a maze of empty storefronts, silent corridors, and impossible spaces where reality bends in subtle and unexpected ways. A place once full of life now feels eerily empty. Yet something still lingers.

Developed by a team of three, Aisle of Shadows is our first project—a short yet intense horror experience inspired by liminal spaces, forgotten memories, and the unsettling side of familiar places.

🎼 Trailer music by: SoundGalleryByDmitryTaras
https://pixabay.com/users/soundgallerybydmitrytaras-11640913/
